arxiv-2104-07465.title: Quantum Origins of the Density Operator
arxiv-2104-07465.creator: Mark G. Kuzyk
arxiv-2104-07465.description: Abstract Students in quantum mechanics class are taught that the wave function contains all knowable information about an isolated system. Later in the course, this view seems to be contradicted by the mysterious density matrix, which introduces a new set of probabilities in addition to those that are built into the wave function.

arxiv-2110-12833.title: Silicon photonic-electronic neural network for fibre nonlinearity compensation
arxiv-2110-12833.creator: Chaoran Huang 1,4, Shinsuke Fujisawa 2, Thomas Ferreira de Lima 1, Alexander N. Tait 1, Eric C. arxiv-2110-12833.description: Abstract In optical communication systems, fibre nonlinearity is the major obstacle in increasing the transmission capacity. Typically, digital signal processing techniques and hardware are used to deal with optical communication signals, but increasing speed and computational complexity create challenges for such approaches.

arxiv-2111-01249.title: Solution of Large-Scale Supply Chain Models using Graph Sampling & Coarsening
arxiv-2111-01249.creator: Jiaze Ma, Victor M. Zavala
arxiv-2111-01249.description: Abstract We present a graph sampling and coarsening scheme (gSC) for computing lower and upper bounds for large-scale supply chain models. An edge sampling scheme is used to build a low-complexity problem that is used to finding an approximate (but feasible) solution for the original model and to compute a lower bound (for a maximization problem).

arxiv-2403-10500.description: Abstract . We introduce and study a three-folded linear operator depending on three parameters that has associated a triangular number tilling of the plane. As a result the set of all triples of integers is decomposed in classes of equivalence organized in four towers of two-dimensional triangulations.

arxiv-2411-16594.title: From Generation to Judgment: Opportunities and Challenges of LLM-as-a-judge
arxiv-2411-16594.creator: Dawei Li, Bohan Jiang, Liangjie Huang, Alimohammad Beigi, Chengshuai Zhao, Zhen Tan, Amrita Bhattacharjee, Yuxuan Jiang, Canyu Chen, Tianhao Wu, Kai Shu, Lu Cheng, Huan Liu
arxiv-2411-16594.description: Abstract Assessment and evaluation have long been critical challenges in artificial intelligence (AI) and natural language processing (NLP). Traditional methods, usually matching-based or small model-based, often fall short in open-ended and dynamic scenarios. Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) inspire the “LLM-as-a-judge” paradigm, where LLMs are leveraged to perform scoring, ranking, or selection for various machine learning evaluation scenarios.

arxiv-2508-00543.title: Towards Efficient Certification of Maritime Remote Operation Centers – Ansatz zur effizienten Zertifizierung von maritimen Fernsteuerungszentren

arxiv-2508-00543.description: Abstract Additional automation being build into ships implies a shift of crew from ship to shore. However, automated ships still have to be monitored and, in some situations, controlled remotely. These tasks are carried out by human operators located in shore-based remote operation centers.

arxiv-2508-14937.creator: Hajrudin Fejzić
arxiv-2508-14937.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hajrudin Fejzić. We investigate a variation of Nicomachus’s identity in which one term in the cubic sum is replaced by a different cube. Specifically, we study the Diophantine identity ∑ j = 1 n j 3 + x 3 − k 3 = ( ∑ j = 1 n j + x − k ) 2 \sum_{j=1}^{n}j^{3}+x^{3}-k^{3}=\left(\sum_{j=1}^{n}j+x-k\right)^{2} and classify all integer solutions ( k , x , n ) (k,x,n) .

arxiv-2512-20838.title: Quantum Ising Model on (2+1)-Dimensional Anti–de Sitter Space using Tensor Networks
arxiv-2512-20838.creator: Simon Catterall, Alexander F. Kemper, Yannick Meurice, Abhishek Samlodia, Goksu Can Toga
arxiv-2512-20838.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Simon Catterall, Alexander F. Kemper, Yannick Meurice, Abhishek Samlodia, Goksu Can Toga. We study the quantum Ising model on (2+1)-dimensional anti-de Sitter space using Matrix Product States (MPS) and Matrix Product Operators (MPOs). Our spatial lattices correspond to regular tessellations of hyperbolic space with coordination number seven. We find the ground state of this model using the Density Matrix Renormalization Group (DMRG) algorithm which allowed us to probe lattices that range in size up to 232 sites.

pmc-11667700.title: Protocol for measuring anti-fentanyl antibodies in mouse serum by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay
pmc-11667700.creator: Jacob A. Koster, Alejandra Prevost-Reilly, Dheeraj Soni, Aisling Kelly, Kristina Walker, Elizabeth B. Norton, Ofer Levy, Colin N. Haile, David J. Dowling
pmc-11667700.description: SummaryEnzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) offers an effective, inexpensive, and reliable approach for the analysis of humoral immune responses. Here, we describe a protocol for measuring anti-fentanyl antibodies generated by the immunization of mice with novel opioid vaccine candidates. We describe steps for coating BSA-fentanyl antigen and standard wells. We then detail procedures for preparing buffers and performing assays.

pmc-12561102.creator: Ellie B Froelich, Neslihan Akdeniz, Kun-Lin Yang
pmc-12561102.description: Anaerobic digestion of manures, crop residues, food waste, and sludge frequently yields biogas with elevated hydrogen sulfide concentrations, which accelerate corrosion and reduce biogas quality. pmc-13170141.title: Identifying the dimensions and components influencing health literacy and self-care in endometriosis: a scoping review
pmc-13170141.creator: Zahra Rostami, Leila Nemati-Anaraki, Shahram Sedghi, Parvaneh Mirabi, Rarzieh Zahedi
pmc-13170141.description: BackgroundEndometriosis is a chronic, progressive inflammatory disorder affecting nearly 10% of reproductive-age women, yet it remains substantially underdiagnosed. Understanding the determinants of health literacy and self-care is therefore essential to improving disease outcomes.

uslaw-usc-t28-s1391.title: 28 U.S.C. § 1391 — Venue generally
uslaw-usc-t28-s1391.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t28-s1391.description: United States Code, Title 28 (Judiciary And Judicial Procedure); Part IV (Jurisdiction And Venue); Chapter 87 (District Courts; Venue). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Applicability of Section.— Except as otherwise provided by law— (1) this section shall govern the venue of all civil actions brought in district courts of the United States; and (2) the proper venue for a civil action.
